g.text: Shelter Map - Shelter API (read + write + community reviews)
addReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : void
updateReview(user : RegisteredUser, shelterId : Long, rating : int, comment : String) : void
Deferred: nearest/bbox queries need GeoService + PostGIS GIST index.
Paging deferred: Estonia-scale data is small; add limit/offset when it grows.
Community rating IS the moderation - no moderator role.
- One review per user per shelter (unique shelterId+userId); re-rating updates
- Requires an authenticated, VERIFIED account (any VerificationClaim)
- Aggregates computed per request in v1; denormalize onto Shelter or
